publicationBoundary: Every figure is first-party, measured on Anton's OWN outbound lists. The deck supports 'my regex ladder failed to classify 22.2% of titles and 34.9% of companies across 13,403 of my own rows' and never an industry rate, never a claim about any vendor's accuracy, and never a benchmark. The point of the deck is that the rate is unmeasured in most pipelines, not that this particular rate is typical.

sources.first-party-csv: Anton's own 5 scored outbound lists, 13,403 rows total, read directly from the scored CSVs on 2026-09-21. Not a client benchmark, not an industry study, and not generalisable to anyone else's list.
